summary: Tested the generate-semester changes: (1) generation is now blocked when the course has no teacher, (2) times that match no standard period become independent weekly cells at their exact time (custom_slot, negative slot_number), (3) conflicts are now checked by real time overlap for the section, teacher and room, (4) GET /weekly-schedule returns the new fields, and (5) the frontend shows the new '⏱ أوقات مستقلة' column and the blocking message. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass against the public URL, using isolated TEST_ seed data (departments, teachers, courses and a room created in the DB and cleaned up afterwards). Frontend: all requested flows verified in Playwright.

minor.issue: Inconsistent handling. The pre-check still matches slot_number exactly and skips custom times. Result: a standard slot that lands on another standard cell is rejected with 409 and no lectures are created. But a standard slot that overlaps another course's custom cell (or a custom time that overlaps a standard cell) returns 200: the lectures ARE created and the overlap only shows up as a weekly_notes entry ('الخلية مشغولة ...'). Verified: D at 08:00 Thursday vs C's custom 08:30-09:00 gave 200 and lectures_created=1. Decide whether custom-time overlaps should also be rejected with 409.

minor.endpoint: POST /api/weekly-schedule (manual add/edit) and the conflicts endpoint (by_time grouping ~line 1099)
minor.issue: These still detect conflicts by exact (day, slot_number) only. Manually adding a standard cell that overlaps an existing custom cell (or one with a negative slot number) for the same section, teacher or room will not be detected. Overlap detection only lives in _reflect_recurring_to_weekly.

Both get times from slot_times[slot_number], so custom cells (negative slot_number) give an empty start time and are silently skipped. Lectures are never generated or resynced from custom cells. They should use actual_start_time/actual_end_time when custom_slot is true.

When checking the teacher's or room's other cells (which may belong to another faculty), _cell_time_range resolves standard cells with the CURRENT faculty's time_slots map. If faculties have different period times, overlaps can be computed wrongly.
If the same course and group already has a cell at a DIFFERENT but overlapping time, it is counted as 'existing' (weekly_cells_existing++) with no note. That silently hides a real time mismatch.

integration_issues.issue: Every weekly_notes entry is shown under '⚠️ الجدول الأسبوعي:' and the notification type becomes 'warning', including the purely informational 'ℹ️ خانة مستقلة ...' note. This contradicts the intent that a custom slot is normal and not a warning. Treat ℹ️ notes as info or success.

issues: Custom items within a day appear in insertion order, not by time (Wednesday showed 20:10 before 07:00). Sort customCells[day] by actual_start_time.
The room line shows a dangling ' | dept' separator when the cell has no room.

The teacher-required block only appears after the user fills the whole form and clicks معاينة. Consider disabling the 'توليد تلقائي' button or warning upfront when the course has no teacher_id and no group teachers.
The sticky red error banner slightly overlaps the room picker area.

action_items: Use the same overlap logic in _weekly_occupancy_conflicts, manual POST/PUT /weekly-schedule and the conflicts report, so custom cells participate in conflict detection everywhere
Make /weekly-schedule/generate-lectures and resync-lecture-times use actual_start_time/actual_end_time for custom_slot cells (currently skipped silently)
Show 'ℹ️' weekly notes as info, not '⚠️' warning, in the course-lectures success notification
Sort custom items by actual_start_time in the custom-slots column
(Optional UX) Disable or warn on 'توليد تلقائي' upfront for courses without a teacher
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ~9403: for custom slots real_end = slot.end_time; end<=start validation happens later in the main loop (it raises 400 before reflection), so this is OK
Busy checks query up to 200 cells per teacher/room/day and resolve every cell with the local faculty's slot map; this can be wrong across faculties
weekly-schedule.tsx handleDeleteSlot swallows errors (catch {}); the user gets no feedback if a delete fails
server.py is 19k+ lines; the generate/reflect logic should move to its own module
